The '''Binarran Cloud''' was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Orthellin system/Legends|Orthellin system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> An affluent [[Orthellin royal mistress/Legends|Orthellin royal mistress]], who at one point owned the [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|luxury yacht]] [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']], originated from the Binarran Cloud.<ref name="Thrawn">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Binarran Cloud was first mentioned in ''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'', a [[1992]] supplement authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="DFRS">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Orthellin [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
